user.title: TV Streamer VM
user.description: The VM that runs the streamer containers (one per TV). After this step, add the streamers in the integration's options and run the VM setup command shown there once on the VM.

data.ha_url: Home Assistant address as seen from the VM

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the VM, e.g. 192.168.1.42. TVs and Moonlight connect to this address.
data_description.ha_url: Used for the start view, the status reports and to fetch the configuration. Use the local address, e.g. 192.168.1.10:8123 (http:// is added).

data.ha_url: Home Assistant address as seen from the VM

abort.already_configured: This VM is already set up.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Saved. The VM fetches the new configuration within 5 minutes.

error.invalid_url: Not a valid address. Examples: 192.168.1.160, loxone.local

init.title: TV Streamer

add_streamer.title: Add streamer
add_streamer.description: The TV type fills in settings that are confirmed for it; you can change them in the next step.

remove_streamer.title: Remove streamer
remove_streamer.description: The container is removed on the next update of the VM. Its browser profile (logins) stays in the Docker volume.

data_description.video_path: MSE: sharpest picture in the TV browser. WebRTC: lowest delay (not on webOS 4). Moonlight: the TV runs the Moonlight app, the VM runs Sunshine – fastest reaction.
data_description.width: Picture size the browser draws. webOS 4 TVs: 1920×1080, webOS 5 and newer: 2560×1440. 4K is too much for software encoding.
data_description.zoom: Page zoom. Page size in points = width ÷ zoom (2560 at 1.67 → 1533 points).
data_description.lg_session_token: Only for LG TVs with Moonlight (developer mode). Paste the token or the whole renewal URL from the webOS Dev Manager. Home Assistant renews the session every day.
data_description.wake_entity: Button or script that switches the TV on, e.g. a Wake on LAN button. Used by "Show on TV" when the TV is off.

add_link.title: Add extra tab
add_link.description: Extra web pages the streamer keeps open in their own tab, e.g. a Loxone or router interface.

data_description.remember_login: The streamer stores the login of this tab in its volume and fills it in again. Only one tab can have this.
data_description.no_reload: For pages that log out on reload (e.g. Loxone).
data_description.url: IP address, host name or full URL – http:// is added if missing, e.g. 192.168.1.160

link.title: Tab {name}
link.description: The name stays – buttons, entity ids and the Moonlight app depend on it. To rename, remove the tab and add it again.

data_description.url: IP address, host name or full URL – http:// is added if missing, e.g. 192.168.1.160
data_description.remember_login: The streamer stores the login of this tab in its volume and fills it in again. Only one tab can have this.
data_description.no_reload: For pages that log out on reload (e.g. Loxone).

data_description.start_url: Path in Home Assistant (e.g. /tv-dashboard/home) or a full URL.
data_description.freeze_after: Seconds without viewers until the dashboard tab rests (empty page, saves CPU). 0 = never.
data_description.home_after: After a Moonlight pause of this many seconds, the stream starts with the start view again (like Loxone after 5 minutes).
data_description.raster_threads: Chromium raster threads (1–4). 4 makes pop-ups noticeably faster.
data_description.image: Image name used by docker compose. With a Dockerfile in /opt/tv-streamer the image is built locally.

vm_setup.title: VM setup
vm_setup.description:
Run this command once as root on the VM. It installs a timer that fetches the configuration from Home Assistant every 5 minutes and restarts the containers when it changed.

```
{command}
```

The command contains the VM token – do not share it.

error.lg_token_invalid: LG did not accept this token. Copy it again from the webOS Dev Manager.
error.lg_token_not_lg: The session token is only used for LG TVs.
error.invalid_url: Not a valid address. Examples: 192.168.1.160, loxone.local

lg_renew_failed.title: LG developer mode of {name} not renewed

init.title: New session token for {name}
init.description:
LG did not renew the developer mode session. Without renewal, the TV removes Moonlight after the session ends.

Open the Developer Mode app on the TV or the webOS Dev Manager, copy the session token (or the renewal URL) and paste it here.

error.lg_token_invalid: LG did not accept this token.
error.lg_unreachable: developer.lge.com is not reachable. Try again later.

lg_renew_failed.message: LG developer mode of {name} could not be renewed. See Settings → Repairs.

no_tv.message: No TV (media player) is set for {name}. Add it in the streamer settings.

tv_off.message: The TV of {name} is off and no switch-on button (Wake on LAN) is set.
